title: Penduduk Taman Dua .
intro: Bak saboh nanggroe nyang le that beureukat, saboh masyarakat tom geunikmati keukayaan dua boh taman nyang meugah. Hudep awaknyan na kheueh saboh bukti keuhai nikmat ilahi, namun kisah awaknyan meuubah watee rasa syukur ka meukureung, nyang jeuet keu saboh transformasi nyang jeuet keu tanda nyang abadi keu mandum ureueng nyang meurenungkan.
clues: Geutanjoë nakeuh saboh bansa njang ka geubri beureukat deungon nanggroë njang mudah dan meu-ulang-ulang.
Tuhan geutanyoe geubri keu geutanyoe dua boh taman nyang lagak, nyang subur dan meuhase nibak tieb-tieb blah.
Geutanyoe geuyue ta syukur, tapi geutanyoe ta pileh hana syukur dan ta meuputa-puta.
Saboh ampéh nyang rayeuk that jitheun ie nyang jibri udep keu tanoh geutanyoe.
Watèë kamoë teutap bak buët kamoë njang hana patôt, ampéh njan ka beureutoh dan ié raya njan ka djisampoë.
Taman-taman kamoe nyang yoh masa dilee subur ka geugantoe ngon boh-boh nyang phet, boh-boh tamarisk, dan padum-padum boh bak kayée lote.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Angen teuga tujoh malam treb jih .
Banjir nyang hanco nibak ampéh nyang beureutoh .
trial.answer: Banjir nyang hanco nibak ampéh nyang beureutoh .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Taman-taman kamoe ka geugantoe ngon boh-boh nyang phet dan bak-bak kayée nyang jarang .
Kamoe jiteubiet lé bumoe lam geumpa bumoe .
Geutanyoe ka meuubah jeuet keu kera ngon bui .
Kamoe ka lhom lam ie raya .
outcome.answer: Taman-taman kamoe ka geugantoe ngon boh-boh nyang phet dan bak-bak kayée nyang jarang .

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
